The regular season commenced on 11 October 2019 and was scheduled to conclude on 26 April 2020, though was postponed to 19 August 2020 as a result of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-06-16/a-league-confirms-season-to-resume-on-july-16/12359184|title=A-League to resume season with Melbourne Victory v Western United on July web|url=https://www.ffa.com.au/news/ffa-postpone-remaining-matches-hyundai-a-league-season-covid-19|title=FFA to postpone remaining matches in the Hyundai A-League season due to web|url=https://www.a-league.com.au/news/football-federation-australia-extends-postponement-hyundai-a-league|title=Football Federation Australia extends the postponement of the Hyundai
